# Welcome
Welcome to my personal website! I am Chengshun Zhao, a Master of Science student in Biostatistics at Columbia University's Mailman School of Public Health.

My academic interests include statistical modeling, data science, machine learning, and the application of quantitative methods to healthcare and business problems.

## About Me
I earned my bachelor's degree in Data Sciences from Pennsylvania State University. My background combines statistical analysis, programming, and practical experience with large datasets.

I have completed internships at Ipsos and Cue Group, where I worked on market research, data quality control, consumer analytics, and business intelligence.
